title: KB3h: (12,6) A-vanish (5,1) PROVEN impossible; (4,2)/(3,3) reduced to exact walkable forms (outcome=partial; no new kappa)
body:
# KB3h: (12,6) A-vanish (5,1) PROVEN impossible; (4,2)/(3,3) reduced to exact walkable forms (outcome=partial, no new kappa)

Contributor: **Aaron Wang**, with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance in scoping, implementation, verification and writing; no model named; no independent human review claimed). No kappa, supplier, certificate or selected-frontier change.

## Change and mathematical scope

In the PR943 prefix-walk model ([PR 943](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/943) by Ross Richardson) a restored seven-source singleton word is universal exactly when its prefix set `P` covers: `P + P = F2^7`. The 17-point question is closed ([PR 2542](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2542), [PR 2634](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2634), [PR 2773](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2773), [PR 2870](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2870)); [PR 2911](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2911) narrowed the 18-point question to the splits `(12,6)`, `(11,7)`, `(10,8)`, `(9,9)` and proved that any `(12,6)` or `(10,8)` cover must have a vanishing character off the all-ones hyperplane; [PR 2933](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2933) classified the vanishing configurations and recorded the class floors; [PR 2961](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2961) decided the three tightest classes and recorded the remainder this PR takes - its open question 1: the surviving non-tight `(12,6)` A-vanish classes `(5,1)`, `(4,2)`, `(3,3)` (D-half splits; floors `36 + x*y` = 41/44/45 against need 32). This PR is strictly SET-level: no words are enumerated.

Record chain, all authors verified against current ground truth with `gh pr view NNN --json author,title` at writing: PR 2542/2634/2773/2870/2911/2933/2961 by Aaron Wang (navinor); [PR 2691](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2691) and [PR 2973](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2973) by Nicholas Stone (NicholasStone); [PR 3005](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3005) by Nick Petalas (petalas).

Concurrent word-level state, recorded honestly: PR 2973 (merged during this session) corrected a false-prune defect in the PR 2542/2634/2691 word-census budgets (bit-0 groups versus Hamming-weight parity; the `n = 4, L = 8` word `01021323` is a counterexample to the old prune) and its corrected census excludes `L = 20`, recording `22 <= f(7) <= 24`; PR 3005 independently corroborates it. PR 2973's own scope note records bit 0 as valid in set-level searches using actual group sizes and the set-level chain PR 2773-2961 as unaffected. Under `22 <= f(7) <= 24` this PR's question is the deciding necessary condition for `f(7) = 22`: at `L = 22` every universal word needs at least 18 distinct prefixes and their set must cover.

## Verdict per class (exact integers)

| Split | Class | PR 2933 floor | Verdict here | Deciding evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| (12,6) | A-vanish (5,1) | 41 >= 32 survives | PROVEN impossible | complete walk: 0 W candidates over 3,049,492,320 normalized pairs |
| (12,6) | A-vanish (4,2) | 44 >= 32 survives | classified, NOT decided | exact reduction to W 4-sets with D1 = 0,1, budgets 20/20/24 |
| (12,6) | A-vanish (3,3) | 45 >= 32 survives | classified, NOT decided | four L3 lines direct, all budgets slack, no forced structure |

Mirrors are identical by odd translation. The `(12,6)` D-vanish classes `(9,3)/(8,4)/(7,5)/(6,6)` and every surviving `(10,8)` class are out of scope here.

## (5,1): exact reduction, complete walk, exact obstruction

`D1 = {d1}` is a singleton, so the two half-translations `U = A0+d1`, `V = A1+d1`, `W = D0+d1` absorb it (each preserves all four PR 2933 L3 lines being all of `F2^5`; machine-checked on random configurations, with the backward round trip). The class is EXACTLY the triples `(U, V 6-sets, W 5-set)` of `F2^5` satisfying `V u (U+W) = F2^5`, `U u (V+W) = F2^5`, `(U+V) u W = F2^5` and the selfsum line `(U+U) u (V+V) u (W+W) u 0 = F2^5`; residual symmetries `U -> U+a, W -> W+a, V -> V+b` give WLOG `0 in U`, `0 in V` (every solution maps bijectively to a normalized one).

Line `(U+V) u W = F2^5` forces `M = F2^5 \ (U+V)` into `W`, so `|M| <= 5` and `|U+V| >= 27`. The walk enumerates every normalized `U` (all 169,911) and per `U` every normalized `V` with `|U+V| >= 27` by a monotone excess-budget backtracking, then derives `W` candidates per pair (`W` must contain `M` and hit the requirement translates of both remaining lines) and tests survivors exactly.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| normalized U walked (0 in U) | 169,911 |
| normalized pairs (U, V) walked (0 in V, sumset size at least 27) | 3,049,492,320 |
| pairs with sumset size 27 | 1,439,907,840 |
| pairs with sumset size 28 | 1,572,086,880 |
| pairs with sumset size 29 | 29,998,080 |
| pairs with sumset size 30 | 7,499,520 |
| W candidates passing all three forced lines | 0 |
| covering configurations | 0 |

The exact obstruction is recorded where it occurs: for EVERY normalized pair, no 5-set `W` containing `M` satisfies the `V u (U+W)` and `U u (V+W)` lines simultaneously (`w_candidates = 0` over the whole walk), so the class is unsatisfiable before the selfsum line is ever relevant. By the reduction's bijectivity: **PROVEN - no covering `(A, D)` exists in class `(12,6)` A-vanish `(5,1)`.**

The walk is 16 shards with per-shard receipts, all `complete=true` / `budget_hit=false`. The first launch hit its 3,000 s per-shard budget with explicit `complete=false` on all 16 shards (partial-as-complete avoided) and was re-walked from scratch at budget 6,000 s (4,365-4,691 s per shard).

## Why a false empty cannot hide here

- Both search engines equal complete brute force on the smallest instances: the per-pair `W` search equals brute force over all 201,376 five-sets on sampled pairs; the pair backtrack equals brute force over all 169,911 normalized `V` at needs 24 and 27 on sampled `U`.
- The optimized decision engine equals the independent reference engine on full `U` slices in the test suite and on 30 randomized slices in a recorded spot recheck (all equal).
- m=3/m=4 analogue control censuses (22 classes with the singleton-D1 shape) agree exactly between the reduction machinery and direct `A + D = E` coverage tests, including cover-bearing positive controls (m=4 A=(1,1) D=(7,1): 512 covers by both routes; m=4 A=(2,2) D=(6,1): 11,648) next to floor-surviving empty controls (m=4 A=(2,2) D=(5,1): 0 covers); semantic failure controls: dropping either forced line changes the census counts.

Receipt-validation trap handled: the anchor walks started from missing receipt files (`fresh receipts confirmed` printed), and two shards (CLASS60 shard 0, CLASS82 shard 2) were re-walked from deleted receipts and compared to their originals semantically with timing fields excluded - identical (`ANCHOR-REPRO.json`).

## (4,2) and (3,3): exact classification, not decided

- `(4,2)`: `D1 = {d1, d1+delta}` normalizes to `{0, 1}` (`delta = 1` under `GL(5,2)`, `d1` absorbed). The class is EXACTLY triples `(U, V 6-sets, W 4-set)` with `(U+W) u (V+0,1) = F2^5`, `(U+0,1) u (V+W) = F2^5`, `(U+V) u (W+0,1) = F2^5` and the selfsum line. Necessary budgets `|U+W| >= 20`, `|V+W| >= 20`, `|U+V| >= 24`. The complete walk is strictly larger than (5,1)'s and was not run in budget.
- `(3,3)`: no singleton absorption exists; the four L3 lines apply directly to `(A0, A1 6-sets, D0, D1 3-sets)` with `0 in A0, 0 in A1` (or `0 in D0, 0 in D1`) WLOG; all budgets slack (line IV: 36+9 against 32) and no forced Sidon structure - the (6,0) rigidity `A0+A1 = F2^5` does not extend.

## Reproduce

Standard library only, CPython 3.12, from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/f7-18point-avtail-seed010d26fa/test_engine.py
python3 -I -B research/f7-18point-avtail-seed010d26fa/verify.py quick
python3 -I -B research/f7-18point-avtail-seed010d26fa/verify.py novanish
python3 -I -B research/f7-18point-avtail-seed010d26fa/verify.py rows
python3 -I -B research/f7-18point-avtail-seed010d26fa/verify.py anchors
python3 -I -B research/f7-18point-avtail-seed010d26fa/verify.py m4
python3 -I -B research/f7-18point-avtail-seed010d26fa/verify.py av51
```

Expected markers: `Ran 10 tests ... OK`, `PASS_AVTAIL_QUICK`, `PASS_AVTAIL_NOVANISH`, `PASS_AVTAIL_ROWS`, `PASS_AVTAIL_ANCHORS`, `PASS_AVTAIL_M4`, `PASS_AVTAIL_AV51`. The walks are resumable with per-shard receipts (`run_avtail.py class71|class82|class60|av51`, then `run_avtail.py merge <mode>`; explicit `complete`/`budget_hit` flags, one progress section per mode). Registered replay: `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/f7-18point-avtail-seed010d26fa --check-only` passes `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.

## Scope and limitations

Set-level only inside PR943's abstract interface. Not checked: anything word-level (PR 2973's corrected word census and the `L = 22` versus `L = 24` question are word-level work, untouched here), the 19-point cover question, walk-realizability of any cover, and any kappa, supplier, tariff or selected-frontier implication. `(4,2)/(3,3)` are not decided; their recorded reductions and budgets are necessary conditions and exact search domains, not exclusions. No construction search was run; the recorded set-level search ceilings stay 118/128 at `k = 18` and 124/128 at `k = 19` (PR 2634's record as quoted by PR 2961). Frozen predecessor packages are unchanged.

## Open next questions

1. **Decide (12,6) A-vanish (4,2)** with the recorded reduced form and budgets; clearing it forces any (12,6) A-vanish cover into (3,3). Blocked by: nothing structural; a few hours of sharded walk.
2. **Decide or identify (12,6) A-vanish (3,3)** via the direct normalized walk or a cross-line multiplicity identity. Blocked by: all four line budgets are slack and no forced structure exists.
3. **Find the (11,7)/(9,9) coupling identity** (PR 2961's open question 2, untouched here): the even-half coverage multiplicities checked first against every odd-odd-split cover of `F2^5` (PR 2933's census) before lifting to `m = 6`.
